title: 3rd Meeting of the Audit Committee

content.string: The meeting is called to order at 12:00 PM; it being noted that I. Cheema was in remote attendance.
That it BE NOTED that no pecuniary interests were disclosed.

motion_texts.string: That the following actions be taken with regards to the Updated Risk-Based Internal Audit Plan:

a) the Internal Audit Plan BE REVISED, in consultation with MNP, to move the compliance audit related to Creating a Safe London for Women and Girls to Q3 of 2024, and to move the compliance audit related to Anti-Racism Anti-Oppression (ARAO) to 2025; and
b) the communication dated November 15, 2023 from MNP with respect to the Updated Risk-Based Internal Audit Plan BE RECEIVED.

attachments.title: 2023-11-15 Submission - Updated Risk-Based Internal Audit Plan

motion_texts.string: That the communication from MNP, with respect to the briefing note from the internal auditor, BE RECEIVED.

attachments.title: 2023-11-15 Submission - Briefing Note From Internal Audit

3.title: Internal Audit Follow Up Activities Dashboard

motion_texts.string: That the communication from MNP, with respect to the internal audit follow up activities update dashboard, BE RECEIVED.

attachments.title: 2023-11-15 Submission - Internal Audit Follow Up Activities Dashboard

motion_texts.string: That the communication dated November 1, 2023 from MNP with respect to the Vendor Risk Management (VRM) Audit BE RECEIVED.
